title: Explosion (Meme)
blurb: Big-budget and clean and entirely disproportionate to whatever prompted it: a proper cinematic detonation rather than a cartoon puff of smoke. Metaphorical explosions are everywhere once you start looking. An argument concluding badly, a secret arriving in a group chat, somebody hitting reply-all on a company-wide email at four in the afternoon — all of those are, technically, explosions. Pair it with a slow zoom onto a single face and resist the urge to cut away too quickly. Let the debris settle. The comedy lives in the aftermath.
origin: A cinematic explosion for metaphorical detonations everywhere.
